x: The winner was Steve Green (Kent) in 10.9. Amongst the spectators was veteran sprinter Duncan Maclean still looking very fit at 80+.
He lined up for a 200 metre race against Fritz Schreiber (Sweden), a mere lad of 82, and Duncan (Tartan Flash) MacLean the 90 year old Scot.

Our veteran veteran runner DUNCAN MacLEAN was recently seen on television on a programme devoted to health and fitness in old age. We saw this remarkable nonagenarian running, dancing, singing and talking.

Our two "supervets" Duncan Maclean and Charlie Speechley were in action at Norbiton track on 29th May. In addition to the Banstead Trophy events there was a Veterans' Sprint Handicap, and our pair were seen in action again.
